name: Freiren
comment: Such a soft and cozy fantasy watch, I loved it sm. The action scenes balanced very well with the slice of life feel.

name: Mob Psycho
comment: Animation was unique and crazy, fight scenes go hard. Mob is a cutie and I loved his journey to self-acceptance <3.

name: Mashle
comment: Same creator as Mob Psycho so I had a great time with this anime. Love the theme of OP protagonists with awkward personalities, they are so adorable. His strength is also hilariously ridiculous. .

name: Apothecary Diaries
comment: Loved the factual and scientific side of it but the romance was so slow 🥲. Maomao is adorable and so intelligent but so cold to Jinshi </3.

name: Blue Lock
comment: Not the biggest fan of football but I learnt some stuff about the game I guess. Didn't really stand out that much.

name: One Punch Man
comment: Another awkward but OP protagonist, I love it. Insane fight scenes. .

name: Bungou Stray Dogs
comment: Really gripping plot and so many creative and unique character designs. I think we basically binged everything in a week :D.

name: Solo Levelling
comment: Classic protag getting OP journey and then becomes unbeatable. It was one of the first light novels I read so I enjoyed the plot and the animation was really good.

name: Haikyuu
comment: First sport anime I ever watched and it was the best thing I ever saw in high school. I loved all the characters and all the matches and now I play volleyball.

name: Bunny Senpai
comment: Not usually a fan of realistic mundane highschool animes but this was alright, it was quite beautiful.

name: Nichijou
comment: It's a silly, slice of life anime about school girls with highly ridiculous moments. Not really my kinda anime.

name: Love is War
comment: A good premise and it has good moments but it got a bit boring.

name: Your Lie in April
comment: Beautiful anime but super sad 😭. Starting to realise I dont think I do super well with anime that predominantly deals emotions and feelings outright that well.

name: Erased
comment: Super thrilling and gripping as it progressed, I was so invested until it got to the end and then it didn't really make sense to me D:

name: Dandadan
comment: Its an incredibly fun anime with so many funny moments and fight scenes. Love the concept, not the highschool nudity as much though.

name: Dr Stone
comment: I loved the scientific aspect of it and the ongoing mystery. Strong plot and strong characters, it was amazingggg.

name: God of Highschool
comment: I loveee the plot and the world building of this anime although the webtoon was so much better, I don't think the anime did it justice 🙂‍↕️

name: Chainsaw Man
comment: It was sooo good, we binged it I think. Unique characters and storyline, I loved their group dynamic very much it was so dumb.

name: Spy x Family
comment: Super cute family dynamic all with their own quirks.
